Equivocation proof management and verification for shreds, with FEC and proof maps.

# Purpose
This C file implements the core state and logic for `eqvoc`, which is an equivocation detection and proof handling component for shred data. It defines the lifecycle functions [`fd_eqvoc_new`](<#fd_eqvoc_new>), [`fd_eqvoc_join`](<#fd_eqvoc_join>), [`fd_eqvoc_leave`](<#fd_eqvoc_leave>), and [`fd_eqvoc_delete`](<#fd_eqvoc_delete>) for a shared-memory object that stores FEC set records, proof records, a SHA-512 context, and Merkle tree memory. The file also sets the slot shred version with [`fd_eqvoc_init`](<#fd_eqvoc_init>) and manages insertion and lookup of FEC entries with [`fd_eqvoc_fec_insert`](<#fd_eqvoc_fec_insert>) and [`fd_eqvoc_fec_search`](<#fd_eqvoc_fec_search>). The search logic checks for conflicts between shreds in the same slot and FEC set, including signature mismatch, index conflicts, and overlap with nearby FEC sets.

The file also defines the proof path for duplicate shred reports. It creates and removes proof records with [`fd_eqvoc_proof_insert`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_insert>) and [`fd_eqvoc_proof_remove`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_remove>), stores proof chunks with [`fd_eqvoc_proof_chunk_insert`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_chunk_insert>), and initializes proof storage with [`fd_eqvoc_proof_init`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_init>). Verification is handled by [`fd_eqvoc_proof_verify`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_verify>) and [`fd_eqvoc_shreds_verify`](<#fd_eqvoc_shreds_verify>), which compare two shreds and return specific result codes for slot, version, type, signature, metadata, last-shred, overlap, and chained-root conflicts. The file also converts between proof objects and gossip chunks with [`fd_eqvoc_proof_from_chunks`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_from_chunks>) and [`fd_eqvoc_proof_to_chunks`](<#fd_eqvoc_proof_to_chunks>), so the proof data can be received and sent in chunked network form.
